tools.description:
Search once with a focused query describing what the code does or its name.

        Write queries using function/class names or behavior descriptions, not error messages.
        Returns file paths and line numbers — navigate directly there, do not repeat the search.
        Pass a git URL or local path as `repo`; indexes are cached for the session.

content.description: Content to search. Defaults to the MCP server's configured content.
content.title: Content

max_snippet_lines.description: Lines of source to include per result. Default (10): function/class signature + first body lines, enough to confirm the location. 0: file path and line range only. None: full chunk (~10-20 lines). If the snippet does not contain enough context to confirm you have the right location, call again with max_snippet_lines=None.
max_snippet_lines.title: Max Snippet Lines

repo.description: A local directory path or https:// or http:// git URL (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo) to index and search, or a list of them to search several repos at once. Indexes are cached after the first call, so repeat queries are fast. Multi-repo results prefix file_path with the repo name.
repo.title: Repo

tools.name: search

tools.description:
Find code similar to a known location.

        Useful for discovering all implementations of an interface, all callers of a function,
        or all tests for a class. Use after `search` when you need related code beyond the primary result.
        Pass `file_path` and `line` from a prior search result.

content.description: Content containing the related file. Defaults to the MCP server configuration.
content.title: Content

file_path.description: Path to the file as stored in the index (use file_path from a search result).
file_path.title: File Path

max_snippet_lines.description: Lines of source per result. Default 10 = signature + first body lines. 0 = location only. None = full chunk.
max_snippet_lines.title: Max Snippet Lines

repo.description: A local directory path or https:// or http:// git URL (e.g. https://github.com/org/repo) to index and search, or a list of them to search several repos at once. Indexes are cached after the first call, so repeat queries are fast. Multi-repo results prefix file_path with the repo name.
repo.title: Repo

top_k.description: Number of similar chunks to return.
top_k.title: Top K

tools.name: find_related
